name: Horizontal Zoom Gallery
description: Full-height horizontal snap gallery of portrait image cards where each image zooms and brightens as it passes the center of the viewport, driven by CSS scroll timelines.
contents: Row of portrait image cards with label and title overlay
Fixed scroll hint text in the bottom left on large screens
behavior: Each image scales up and brightens at the center using a CSS view timeline, falling back to static images where unsupported
Card ring and overlay react on hover
editableByProps: Number of cards, images, alt text, labels and titles
Zoom strength, hint text, background, text and hint colors

needsCodeEdit.change: Change card width or aspect ratio
needsCodeEdit.where: aspect-[3/4] and w-[75vw] classes on the zoom-track div

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the brightness and grayscale of the zoom effect
needsCodeEdit.where: modernZoom keyframes in the style block

fixed: Zoom animation needs browser support for CSS scroll-driven animations, otherwise images stay static
Scroll hint is positioned fixed to the viewport and hidden below the lg breakpoint
Gallery section fills the viewport height
